text: The Nornisath Chapterhouse has exactly one custodian of record, but the register never prints that custodian's name in full. What is the custodian's full name? Reply with the given name followed by the family name, and nothing else.
needle_text:
[custodial register] the Nornisath Chapterhouse enters each custodian across two separate lines and never prints a custodian's name in full.
GIVEN . . . . . . Zanelade
SEAL  . . . . . . intact
TERM  . . . . . . open
FAMILY  . . . . . Holkerath
Those two entries are the only custodian of record for this trust; no other custodian is entered anywhere in the register.
